task_instance: Specify a new, minimal NVIDIA PVA operator (AddSaturateU8: elementwise saturating uint8 add with a dimension-match precondition and no-alias rule) from a plain-language description: author the three model outputs (operator-spec.json, test-matrix.json, evidence.json) from the skill's templates, then create and validate the deterministic Spec-to-OpGen handoff with the skill's bundled finalizer script.
evidence: Copied the three bundled templates' structure into project/configure/ and filled them for operator AddSaturateU8 with two requirements (REQ-ADD-SAT, REQ-DIMS), three correctness cases (no-clamp add, saturating clamp to 255, dimension-mismatch invalid-argument), full requirement coverage, status CONFIGURED, EMU policy optional, hardware required, no blocking unresolved items. Supplied the skill's structural Doctor-report fixture as the prerequisite report (content only hashed by the script). Ran the bundled finalizer: python3 scripts/finalize_opgen_inputs.py --operator-spec ... --test-matrix ... --evidence ... --doctor-report ... --workspace <project> --output .../opgen-inputs.json -> printed {"result":"VALID","mode":"create","requirements":2,"correctness_cases":3,"performance_cases":0} exit 0. Re-ran with --check on the produced opgen-inputs.json -> {"result":"VALID","mode":"check",...} exit 0. Verified the validator is real by tampering a copied handoff (set counts.requirements=99); --check then failed with 'OpGen input manifest is stale or was changed; differing fields: counts' exit 1. Deliverables produced and verified: project/configure/operator-spec.json, test-matrix.json, evidence.json, opgen-inputs.json (schema_version 3, result CONFIGURED, recorded SHA-256 of each input) and project/reports/configure-report.md. python3 3.13.17 present; finalizer is pure-stdlib, no installs needed. Note: the skill's model-side 'Verify references' step against a live NVIDIA PVA SDK reference corpus / full Doctor readiness report was not exercised because no such corpus was supplied in this runtime; it is a user/pipeline-supplied input, not a runtime capability, and the skill's own deliverable-producing and validation scripts ran end to end successfully.
